scenario.title: Test 4: Missing Original Documents Disqualification
dialogue: Actually I only have photocopies, the original documents were misplaced.

final_state.disqualification_reason: Original property documents are mandatory for verification.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Amit Saxena, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Amit Saxena?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Actually I only have photocopies, the original documents were misplaced.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you for your honesty, Amit Saxena. As per regulatory guidelines for Loan Against Property, physical verification of the original property documents is mandatory. Since originals are not available at this time, we are unable to proceed further with this application. Thank you for your time with Home Credit!
